WITH race_name_totals AS (
  SELECT races.name, SUM(CAST(results.points AS REAL)) AS total_points
  FROM races
  JOIN results ON results.raceId = races.raceId
  GROUP BY races.name
), above_average AS (
  SELECT name, total_points
  FROM race_name_totals
  WHERE total_points > (SELECT AVG(total_points) FROM race_name_totals)
)
SELECT
  SUM(results.points) AS combined_total_points,
  AVG(CAST(results.laps AS REAL)) AS average_laps_completed,
  AVG(above_average.total_points - (SELECT AVG(total_points) FROM race_name_totals)) AS average_excess_over_average
FROM above_average
JOIN races ON races.name = above_average.name
JOIN results ON results.raceId = races.raceId
